lead: A complete vitamin supplement for reptiles. Contains vitamins A, D3, E and essential nutrients for optimal health.

description.html: Arcadia EarthPro-A is a comprehensive vitamin supplement designed for all reptile species. Vitamin A is key for healthy vision, immunity and skin tissue development. D3 enables proper calcium absorption, while vitamin E acts as an antioxidant and protects cells from free radical damage.

Use once a week by dusting it over food right before feeding, while a calcium supplement is used daily. This alternating protocol provides a balance of vitamins and minerals without the risk of overdose. Overuse of vitamin supplements, especially vitamin A, can be harmful - stick strictly to the recommended dose.

EarthPro-A was developed in collaboration with herpetologists and veterinarians who specialize in exotic animals. It is compatible with the entire Arcadia EarthPro line and is especially recommended with EarthPro-Ca or CaPro-MG as the daily calcium.
